details.tlsClientCertificate: X.509 workload certificate issued by the cluster PKI, rotated automatically
details.note: No end-user authentication exists anywhere in the system (none exists in the source and none is introduced). mTLS authenticates the calling workload only.
details.tokenPropagation: none (no user token exists); X-Correlation-Id and W3C traceparent are propagated instead

authorization.rationale: OD-007 confirmed: the calling workload identity is the only authorization signal; no user roles or scopes exist in this system.

rateLimiting.onExceeded: 429 with problem+json; the caller must not retry a 429

cors.rationale: Cluster-internal service-to-service call; no browser origin is involved.

ipAllowList: cluster pod CIDR only - enforced by a default-deny NetworkPolicy that admits traffic from the listed workload identities
network.externalRoute: none (OD-007 confirmed: the three backend services must be unreachable from outside the cluster)
